therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with low-grade serous ovarian, fallopian tube, or peritoneal cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Progression-free survival (PFS) as assessed by blinded independent central review

results.effect_size: Median PFS: MEK162 9.10 months (95% CI: 7.29-11.30) vs Physician's Choice 10.58 months (95% CI: 9.20-14.52)
results.target_engagement_evidence: Plasma concentrations achieved: Ctrough 42.2-69.3 ng/mL, Cmax 304-343 ng/mL
safety_signals: Higher rates of serious adverse events in MEK162 arm (126/227) vs control (31/105)
Notable GI toxicity: small intestinal obstruction, vomiting, intestinal obstruction, diarrhea
Elevated creatine kinase: Grade 3 in 52 patients, Grade 4 in 12 patients (MEK162 arm only)
Quality of life scores consistently lower in MEK162 arm across multiple domains
results.dose_information: MEK162 oral, multiple dose single schedule

context.comparator: Physician's choice chemotherapy (liposomal doxorubicin, paclitaxel, or topotecan)
